```bash
supervisorctl status watcher | grep -q RUNNING && echo ok > /watched/x && sleep 2 && grep -q /watched/x /var/log/watcher.log && echo SUCCESS
```

One note: avoid truncating/removing `/var/log/watcher.log` while the program runs — supervisord holds the fd, so writes would go to the unlinked inode. Use `supervisorctl restart watcher` to reopen it.
